subtitle: Performance Overdrive & Intelligence Refinement
changes: Added optional Talent Forge Performance Overdrive selector: Auto adapts lightweight tree effects for small screens and reduced-motion settings, Full keeps the original visuals, and Lite suppresses expensive decorations without changing talent geometry or allocations.
Character Intelligence now shows returned equipment in incremental batches of sixteen with a Show Next button, reducing initial DOM construction for longer lookup results.
Updated the equipment list to build rows through a document fragment, and reset the display batch safely when the sort order or returned character changes.
Visual performance choice uses a separate harmless local preference, with no new API requests and no changes to existing saved character, equipment, talent, media or account records.
Retained v7.4 gear comparisons, developer identity, studio archive, Blizzard research, music and Discord release system. Full live-device benchmark and acceptance testing remain pending.
